confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for a surf town on Sri Lanka's east coast, priced for July (peak season there). Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident; accommodation anchors are less certain and are bounded to the tourist-town range I know. Wine is inferred from the local beer relationship because imported wine is heavily taxed and direct knowledge is weak. Taxes and service charges are included in accommodation figures per the definition. FX value was taken from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rate table, not from a directly opened page, and the 16 October 2026 figure could not be confirmed as published.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Sri Lankan southern and east-coast beach-tourism towns (for example Mirissa and Unawatuna) with adjustments for Arugam Bay's surf-tourism demand in July and its guesthouse-heavy accommodation mix. Drink prices reflect Sri Lanka's high alcohol taxes.
